## Summary

Describe the problem and the user-visible or operational outcome.

## Validation

- [ ] `uv lock --check`
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] Added or updated behavior-focused tests where needed

## Security and operations

- [ ] No secrets, credential-bearing URLs, local state, logs, or generated reports are included
- [ ] Configuration, deployment, and documentation changes are described
- [ ] No public-release checklist item is bypassed
